study: fixed-bandwidth tail postcoloring: finite-sample mechanism diagnostics
status: diagnostic, not a new calibrated audit method
random_address: SeedSequence([root_seed, 21, group_id, replicate, 0]); independently addressed replicates
critical_value: known-correlation Gaussian maximum, with exact finite-T mean variance; shared by all diagnostic scales
parameter_estimator: centered lag-1 autocovariance / centered lag-0 autocovariance, both with divisor T, matching paper Example 3.1; not the authors' tseries::arma wrapper
null: stationary zero-mean Gaussian AR(1), marginal variance one, common AR parameter; independent common and idiosyncratic AR components
pairing: same underlying component draws within each group, across rho and nested K; same data across all estimators
invalid_estimates: abort and preserve incomplete status; never drop a replicate
outputs: all replicate statistics, decisions, selected indices, selected finite-T variance ratios and fitted AR parameters; paired discordant counts; source/protocol/output hashes
intervals: pointwise Wilson rejection intervals and descriptive normal paired-risk-difference intervals; McNemar p-values are unadjusted and not confirmatory claims
scope: known rho in every comparison; only oracle has exact Gaussian scaling. Other Gaussian-tail scores are diagnostics, not valid p-values. Fixed bandwidth; does not reproduce adaptive paper Table B.7. No size-matched power or plug-in covariance validity claimed.
